1. DEFINITIONS

   "Font Software" means the fonts named below, including every font file (TTF, WOFF2) in any format or
   version, the accompanying CSS and documentation, and any updates we provide:
       "Saguna Mono" and "Saguna Mono Variable".
   It does not include the free styles listed above.
   "Order" means the order confirmation or receipt issued by us, or by our reseller acting for us, that
   states the licence type and quantities you paid for.
   "Device" means one computer, tablet, phone or other device on which the Font Software is installed.
   "Domain" means one website domain name, including its subdomains (for example example.com and
   www.example.com, shop.example.com).
   "Page View" means one request by a visitor's browser for a web page that uses the Font Software.
   "Affiliate" means a company that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with you.

2. LICENCE GRANT

   Subject to this Agreement and payment of the fee for your Order, we grant you a non-exclusive,
   non-transferable (except under clause 9), worldwide, perpetual licence to use the Font Software as
   follows. Unless your Order states otherwise, the quantities below apply.

   (a) Desktop Licence: install and use the Font Software on up to 5 Devices used by you or your
       employees, to create documents, images, designs, videos, printed matter, logos and other static
       output, including commercial work for yourself and your clients.
   (b) Web Licence: self-host the WOFF2 files to display text on 1 Domain with up to 100,000 Page Views
       per month in total, served from a server you control and referenced only by pages on that Domain.
   (c) Desktop and Web Licence: both (a) and (b).
   (d) Documents: embed the Font Software in PDF and similar documents you distribute, provided it is
       subset or embedded for viewing and printing only, so that recipients cannot extract it or use it
       to edit text.
   (e) Larger use and other media: use beyond these quantities, and use in apps, games, e-books,
       software, hardware, broadcast or any product you distribute in which the Font Software itself is
       embedded, requires an Order or a separate written licence that covers it.

   Your contractors may use the Font Software solely to do work for you, provided they comply with this
   Agreement and remove it when that work ends; you are responsible for their compliance. Your
   Affiliates may not use the Font Software unless your Order includes them.

3. RESTRICTIONS

   Except as this Agreement expressly allows, you must not, and must not allow anyone else to:
   (a) copy the Font Software, except for installation as licensed and one backup copy;
   (b) sell, rent, lend, sublicense, share, distribute or publish the Font Software, including on public
       code repositories, font-sharing sites or file-sharing services, or make it available for others to
       download from your servers;
   (c) modify, adapt, translate, convert or create derivative fonts from the Font Software, or decompile
       or extract its outlines or data, except as permitted by law despite this restriction (for example,
       to achieve interoperability) or as needed to subset it for web or document use under clause 2;
   (d) remove or alter copyright notices, trademarks or the font's embedded metadata; or
   (e) use the name "Saguna Mono" or "Partech Systems Limited" to identify any other font.

   The text, images, designs and other output you create with the Font Software are yours, and you may
   use them freely, including after this Agreement ends.

4. OWNERSHIP

   The Font Software is licensed, not sold. We and our licensors keep all rights, title and interest in
   it, including copyright, design rights and trademarks. Every copy you make is subject to this
   Agreement. All rights not expressly granted are reserved.

5. UPDATES AND SUPPORT

   Updates we release within the same major version (for example 2.000 to 2.999) are included in your
   licence and are governed by this Agreement. We have no obligation to provide updates or support,
   though we will help where we reasonably can: https://partechsystems.com/contact/

6. TERM AND TERMINATION

   This Agreement continues until terminated. You may end it at any time by deleting all copies of the
   Font Software. We may end it by written notice if you materially breach it and, where the breach can
   be remedied, you do not remedy it within 30 days of our notice. When it ends you must stop using and
   delete all copies of the Font Software; output you created while licensed is not affected. Clauses 3,
   4, 8, 11 and 12 survive termination.

7. WARRANTY

   We warrant that, for 90 days from your Order, the Font Software will perform substantially as
   described in its documentation. If it does not, tell us within that period and we will, at our
   option, fix or replace it or refund the fee you paid for it. Except as stated in this clause and to
   the extent permitted by law, the Font Software is provided "as is" and we give no other warranties,
   conditions or terms, whether express or implied, including as to satisfactory quality or fitness for
   a particular purpose.

   (a) Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes liability for death or personal injury caused by

   (b) Subject to (a), we are not liable, whether in contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise,

   (c) Subject to (a), our total liability under or in connection with this Agreement is limited to the

9. TRANSFER

   You may transfer this licence once, in full, to a person or organisation that takes over the business

10. CONSUMERS

   If you buy as a consumer rather than for a business, nothing in this Agreement affects your statutory
